items.description: Sec. 4 and Table A.5 give only a '20 × 60 finite-element grid'. They do not say which count is horizontal, and they give no element aspect ratio or physical size (square unit elements are implied only by the Top88 reference). The 'complete horizontal domain' remark in Sec. 5.1 and the Top88 half-MBB (nelx=60, nely=20) suggest a wide domain but do not state it.
readings: 60 elements horizontal × 20 vertical (nelx=60, nely=20), square unit elements, 3:1 wide domain
20 elements horizontal × 60 vertical (nelx=20, nely=60), square unit elements, 1:3 tall domain

items.entity: unit downward point load on the right edge (Fig. 5(c) case)
items.description: Sec. 4 places the load at a 'randomly selected admissible node on the lower, upper, or right boundary region'. Sec. 5.1 says only that Fig. 5(c) uses 'right-edge loading'. The sample index is not given, and the node's height on the right edge is shown only in the figure.
readings: top-right corner node (1.0 of height, measured from bottom)
right edge at mid-height (0.5 of height)

items.description: Sec. 4 applies the unit load to a single node. Eq. 5 instead describes the load channel F as 'nonzero at the loaded element'. If the load location is read from the element-wise channel or figure, the actual node(s) are uncertain by about one element.
readings: full unit load on a single right-edge node
unit load split equally over the two right-edge nodes of the marked element
full unit load on the upper (or lower) right-edge node of the marked element, i.e. a half-element offset

items.entity: target volume fraction of the Fig. 5(c) problem
items.description: Sec. 4 says only that dataset volume fractions are sampled uniformly from [0.3, 0.7]. Sec. 5.1 says the 'volume target' is held identical across the Fig. 5(c) rows but never gives its value. The only stated value, 0.5, belongs to the unrelated half-MBB run in Table A.5. At best the value could be estimated from the grey level of the 'shared init' column.
Sec. 2.1 says sensitivities are regularized by 'standard convolution filtering [3,4]'; Sec. 6 and A.5 confirm it is a sensitivity filter. The filter radius and its units are never given.

items.entity: solid Young's modulus E0 (and out-of-plane thickness)
items.description: Eq. 2 introduces E0 but gives no value, and thickness is never stated. Both set the absolute compliance shown in the Fig. 5(c) panel titles.

items.entity: void modulus E_min / density lower bound
items.description: Eq. 2 uses a 'near-void' E_min without a value. Eq. 1 allows densities in [0,1], but Sec. 4 clips the initial field to [0.001, 1], which hints at a possible density floor.
readings: E_min = 0 with density floor 0.001, i.e. E = ρ^3·E0 (99-line style)

items.description: Never stated anywhere in the text.
The text gives only a '20 × 60 finite-element grid' and names a 'Top88/SIMP optimizer' in A.5. Plane stress vs plane strain and the element type are not stated.
Sec. 2.1 refers only to 'optimality-criteria updates [31]'. No move limit, damping exponent or Lagrange-multiplier bisection tolerance is given.
readings: move limit 0.2, damping exponent 0.5, bisection tolerance 1e-3 (Top88 defaults)

items.description: No tolerance or iteration cap is given for generating the SIMP reference. Table A.5 covers a different half-MBB problem: there the non-converged runs stop at exactly 100 iterations, which implies a 100-iteration cap for that experiment only.
readings: max density change < 0.01, no iteration cap (Top88)
max density change < 0.01 or 100 iterations, whichever comes first

items.entity: starting density field of the SIMP reference run
items.description: Sec. 4 sets ρ_init to the target volume fraction 'perturbed by Gaussian-smoothed random variation with amplitude 0.05', clipped to [0.001, 1.0]. It gives no smoothing width, no seed and no definition of 'amplitude', and the actual field appears only in the 'shared init' column of Fig. 5(c). Sec. 5.4 ('only the starting density field differs from the reference (clean) run') implies the SIMP reference started from this field. Standard Top88 instead starts from a uniform field.
readings: uniform density equal to the volume fraction everywhere
volume fraction + Gaussian-smoothed random field with peak deviation 0.05, clipped to [0.001, 1]
volume fraction + Gaussian-smoothed random field with standard deviation 0.05, clipped to [0.001, 1]

items.entity: compliance evaluation of the SIMP reference (panel-title value c)
items.description: Sec. 5.1 and Fig. 5(b)-(c) report 'thresholded' compliance and an absolute c in the panel titles. They do not give the threshold value, or say whether the SIMP reference itself (the denominator of Eq. 13) is thresholded or evaluated as a grey field.
readings: compliance of the raw grey-scale SIMP density field
compliance of the SIMP field thresholded at 0.5 (solid = E0, void = E_min)
compliance of the SIMP field thresholded at the volume-preserving level
